title: Semidefinite optimum
statement: Let $G$ be a weighted directed graph on the vertex set $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$. Its semidefinite optimum is the supremum of the objective values attained by assignments $U_v\\in\\mathbb{R}^n$ that satisfy the semidefinite-program assignment condition.
